title: List comprehensions & ranges
hints: README 'New syntax': comprehensions `[result | generator, guard]` and ranges `[a .. b]`. Each answer is a one-liner.

evensUpTo: draw from 1..n, keep the even ones. pythagorean: three generators arranged so a ≤ b ≤ c (later ranges stop at earlier variables), plus a guard a²+b² == c². grid: two generators. lettersFrom: a Char range ending at 'z'. multiplicationTable: a comprehension (one row) inside a comprehension (all rows).
`pythagorean n = [(a, b, c) | c <- [1 .. n], b <- [1 .. c], a <- [1 .. b], a * a + b * b == c * c]` · `multiplicationTable n = [[r * c | c <- [1 .. n]] | r <- [1 .. n]]`.
